companyDescription: AI Drug Discovery · Combines machine learning + biology OS to decode disease at scale — partnered with Roche/Genentech and NVIDIA for AI-powered therapeutics pipeline
priceNote: ARK Invest bought 260K shares June 24; founder Chris Gibson stepping back — CEO Najat Khan refocusing on pipeline execution
summary: Recursion's AI-powered drug discovery OS is a genuine platform play with Roche/Genentech and NVIDIA partnerships providing validation. The stock is at multi-year lows near $3.52 with massive upside to analyst targets ($6-8). The binary event is REC-4881 Phase 2 data in 2H26 showing 43-53% polyp burden reduction — a potential registrational pathway.

catalysts.name: REC-4881 Phase 2 Data Readout 2H26
catalysts.description: FAP drug showed median 43% polyp reduction at Week 13, deepening to 53% at Week 25. FDA engagement initiated. 2H26 update could define registrational pathway — the primary re-rating event.

catalysts.name: ARK Invest Accumulation Signal
catalysts.description: Cathie Wood's ARK bought 260K shares on June 24, 2026. ARK has deep AI conviction and typically accumulates multi-quarter. Their buy signals platform confidence at current depressed valuations.

catalysts.name: REC-617 CDK7 Phase 1 Data
catalysts.description: Early Phase 1 data for REC-617 (CDK7 inhibitor) expected 1H27. Oncology pipeline that could be the next re-rating catalyst if safety profile confirms.

entryStrategy.verdict: SPECULATIVE — ค่าขนม 3-5% max; ARK buying at these levels is the best near-term signal. Hold through 2H26 REC-4881 data — that is the only catalyst that matters.

catalystSpot.preRunup: AI biotech names with clinical catalysts typically see 20-40% pre-announcement runs as informed money positions 4-6 weeks ahead. RXRX has been largely suppressed due to leadership transition, leaving potential for a sharp re-rating on positive signal.

postWin.note: Small biotech Phase 2 successes with FDA engagement typically generate 60-120% moves. Relay Therapeutics (RLAY) gained +85% on Phase 2 tumor data in Jun 2023. RXRX at $3.52 with positive REC-4881 FDA path could see similar magnitude.

postLose.note: Phase 2 efficacy misses in oncology/rare disease typically produce -40-60% selloffs. Kymera (KYMR) fell -52% on Phase 2 miss in Aug 2024. RXRX at $3.52 has less downside than from higher levels but risk remains severe.

spotSizing.reason: High upside to analyst targets but binary clinical event = lottery ticket sizing. ARK accumulation provides conviction floor. Max 4% allocation.
